input.quote: A. Throughout the Term of this Agreement, M&I shall maintain at all times at its own cost and expense:
input.rationale: Section 14.1(A) contains a real insurance schedule (CGL with primary limits of $2,000,000, fidelity $10,000,000, workers' compensation as mandated by the state plus $500,000 employer's liability, and all risk property), and 14.1(B) requires original Certificates of Insurance at Customer's request. However, it contains no professional liability (E&O) coverage and no cyber/privacy coverage, so it fails both fallback elements for a vendor that processes our data and Items. We therefore target the fallback and insert a single new item adding E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000; the existing certificate and cancellation-notice mechanic in 14.1(B) already extends to "the coverage required by this Section", so no further change is needed. We did not push the preferred CGL split limits or the higher preferred E&O/cyber amounts, as the fallback thresholds are acceptable.

proposal.summary: Add E&O and cyber/privacy coverage to M&I's insurance schedule in 14.1(A)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.1(A) omits professional liability and cyber coverage, which we require for a vendor that processes our customer data. We have added E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000 at our fallback limits, leaving the existing coverages and certificate mechanic untouched.

ops.text: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance in an amount not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000), and Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000).

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
